hero_sub_es: montejazmin.com · Colombia · Pereira · Etapa: Pre-Seed · CT-AF-001
pitch_en: Three-generation agroecological coffee farm and nature reserve offering specialty coffee, regenerative agritourism, and seed-to-cup experiences near Pereira.
pitch_es: Finca cafetera agroecológica multigeneracional y reserva natural que ofrece café especialidad, agroturismo regenerativo y experiencias de grano a taza cerca de Pereira.
cta_pitch_en: CleantechHUB CLAC22 portfolio card — civil-society nature reserve certification and rural lodging.
cta_pitch_es: Tarjeta de portafolio CLAC22 CleantechHUB — certificación de reserva natural de la sociedad civil y alojamiento rural.

sections.head_en: Coffee landscapes need models that combine livelihoods, biodiversity conservation, and authentic visitor experiences.
sections.head_es: Los paisajes cafeteros necesitan modelos que combinen medios de vida, conservación de biodiversidad y experiencias auténticas para visitantes.
sections.body_en: Traditional farms rarely connect specialty production, ecotourism, and protected-area stewardship in one regenerative operating model.
sections.body_es: Las fincas tradicionales rara vez conectan producción de especialidad, ecoturismo y custodia de áreas protegidas en un modelo regenerativo integrado.

steps.text_en: Agroecological coffee, rural lodging, guided coffee journeys, and nature-based tourism in Pereira.
